mapper.sql: m.id, m.parent_id, m.permission_id, m.name, m.type, m.sort, m.icon, m.status, m.is_deleted, m.create_time, m.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.parent_id AS parentId, m.name, m.type, m.sort, m.icon, m.status, p.path AS permissionPath, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_sys_menu m LEFT JOIN t_sys_permission p ON p.id = m.permission_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.type IN (1, 2) AND m.id IN (SELECT tsr.menu_id FROM t_sys_role_menu tsr JOIN t_sys_user_role tsur ON tsur.role_id = tsr.role_id WHERE tsur.user_id = #{userId} AND tsur.is_deleted = 0 AND tsr.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 0

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT id FROM t_sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM t_sys_menu m INNER JOIN sub ON m.parent_id = sub.id WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT id FROM sub
